title: docs(plugins): author the `listViews` filter operator in its canonical spelling (objectui#7993)
body:
Fixes #7993

One token in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx`: the saved-views (`listViews`) example
now authors `operator: 'less_than'` instead of the deprecated camelCase alias
`operator: 'lessThan'`. No prose change, no contract change, no other page.

## Why this is correct — and what does NOT establish it

The ground is `@objectstack/spec`'s own words. `VIEW_FILTER_OPERATOR_ALIASES` documents the
camelCase spellings as *"Deprecated: new producers MUST emit the canonical forms; these
aliases are a migration bridge and may be dropped in a future major."* A documentation
example is a new producer, and a reader who copies it inherits a spelling scheduled for
removal.

**No gate sees this, before or after the change.** The fence this line sits in is annotated
`const productViews: ObjectViewSchema` (`@object-ui/types`, not `@objectstack/spec`), and the
`filter` key on that type's named-view shape is declared `any[]` — so `check:doc-snippets`
type-checks `lessThan`, `less_than` and `nonsense` identically. Any green from the doc gates
on this pull request proves the page still compiles; it is ⛔ not evidence that the operator
spelling is right. The evidence is the alias table quoted above plus a direct reading of the
page — stated here because nothing re-derives it (AGENTS.md commandment #9).

## Measurements re-derived on this branch's base (`f0f4d6c`)

- **Line number.** The card's `plugin-view.mdx:399` was recorded on 2026-09-06 (`36fc746`)
  and is line-addressed, so it was re-derived rather than trusted. It still holds: the
  `filter:` block is at line 399 today, inside the `listViews.cheap` view of the
  `const productViews: ObjectViewSchema` fence.
- **Page census.** Every key of `VIEW_FILTER_OPERATOR_ALIASES` was swept across the whole
  page as a standalone token, ⛔ not just the one the card named: **exactly one** hit,
  `lessThan` at line 399. The page's two other operator literals (`equals`, lines 379 and
  523) are canonical members of `VIEW_FILTER_OPERATORS`, not aliases.
- **Alias table.** Re-derived against the installed `@objectstack/spec` **17.4.0** through the
  `./ui` subpath export — the root `.` export carries none of these symbols (confirmed:
  `VIEW_FILTER_OPERATOR_ALIASES`, `VIEW_FILTER_OPERATORS` and `normalizeFilterOperator` are all
  absent from it). `ALIASES.lessThan === 'less_than'`, `normalizeFilterOperator('lessThan') === 'less_than'`,
  `VIEW_FILTER_OPERATORS.includes('lessThan') === false`, `.includes('less_than') === true`.
  The alias still resolves today, so nothing breaks until the bridge is dropped — this teaches a
  deprecated form, it does not produce a runtime error.

## Gates

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` refuses objectui paths (exit 2), so the list below was derived
from this repo's own root `package.json` scripts and `.github/workflows/` triggers. Exit codes
were captured on their own line, never after a pipe.

| Gate | Exit | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| `check-doc-fence-languages.mjs --self-test` + full run | 0 + 0 | pass |
| `check-doc-component-types.mjs` | 0 | pass |
| `check-prompt-component-keys.mjs` | 0 | pass |
| `check-doc-example-ids.mjs` | 0 | pass |
| `check-doc-links.mjs` | 0 | pass |
| `check-control-bytes.mjs` | 0 | pass |
| `check-shell-escape-residue.mjs` | 0 | pass |
| `check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs` | 0 | 0 new citations, report-only |
| `check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 | "no changeset is owed" — 1 file changed, 0 of them published source |
| `vitest run packages/types/src/__tests__/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts` | 0 | 164 passed; this is the test that reads this page |
| `check:doc-snippets` / `check:doc-examples` | 2 | see below |

`check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples` print **PRECONDITION NOT MET (exit 2)** without a
prior scoped build of the 34 packages the covered documents import. That is NOT MEASURED, ⛔ not
a pass — and per the paragraph above, a green from them would not have been evidence for this
change either.

## Acceptance notes

Out of scope here, reported rather than touched:

- `packages/plugin-view/README.md:464` carries the **same example with the same `lessThan`
  spelling** — the package README mirrors this page. The card's triage census was scoped to
  `content/docs/` and therefore did not see it, so "population is one line" is true of the docs
  tree and false of the repository. It is a different file from this card's declared surface, so
  it is left alone here; after this pull request the doc and its README mirror disagree on this
  token. Related: objectui#7993 (this card), no keyword.
- `content/docs/components/complex/filter-ui.mdx` documents `FilterUISchema.filters[].operator`
  as `'equals' | 'contains' | 'startsWith' | 'gt' | 'lt' | 'between' | 'in'` — three of those
  seven (`startsWith`, `gt`, `lt`) are deprecated alias keys. Whether that component's operator
  vocabulary is governed by the spec's `ViewFilter` at all is unverified; the fence is
  `plaintext`, so nothing type-checks it either.
- What would have caught this and does not exist: the class shared with objectui#7971,
  objectui#7713 and objectui#7972 is "an authored literal whose enum is never consulted". The
  cheap instrument that is visible from here is a scan of `content/docs/**` and package
  `README.md` files for `operator:` literals, judged against the spec's exported
  `VIEW_FILTER_OPERATORS` / `VIEW_FILTER_OPERATOR_ALIASES` — the same three-line derivation used
  above, which found three non-canonical literals across 184 documentation files in under a
  second. ⛔ Not built here.

Sibling objectui#8255 edits this same document at a different line and was not dispatched; this
branch stays off its lines.
